title: IBM's Power11 Processor
problem: High-performance server and HPC workloads require next-generation processors with improved single-thread performance, power efficiency, and memory bandwidth.
motivation: Enterprise computing and scientific computing demand higher per-core performance and energy efficiency to handle complex workloads and machine learning tasks.
method: IBM Power11 builds on the POWER ISA with enhanced core microarchitecture, improved cache hierarchy, memory controllers, and accelerators for specialized workloads.
key_novelty: Next-generation POWER ISA implementation with architectural improvements for enterprise and HPC workloads.
contributions: Enhanced memory system and cache hierarchy
